routes.name: I-70 West (Primary Route)
routes.description: Most direct route via Eisenhower Tunnel, Vail, and Glenwood Canyon

waypoints.name: Idaho Springs
waypoints.description: First stop for coffee or breakfast, 30 miles from Denver

waypoints.name: Silverthorne/Dillon
waypoints.description: Extensive services including gas, restaurants, grocery stores - logical midpoint stop

waypoints.name: Glenwood Springs
waypoints.description: Preferred lunch stop with hot springs, roughly halfway through journey

waypoints.name: Grand Junction
waypoints.description: Last full-service city before Telluride - stock up on supplies

waypoints.name: Montrose
waypoints.description: Final services before last 65-mile push to Telluride, lower gas prices

routes.name: US-285 South (Alternative Route)
routes.description: Avoids I-70 traffic via Monarch Pass, adds 20 miles but can be faster during peak times

waypoints.name: Fairplay
waypoints.description: Authentic mountain community in South Park basin

waypoints.name: Monarch Pass
waypoints.description: Continental Divide crossing at 11,312 feet elevation

waypoints.name: Poncha Springs
waypoints.description: Junction point where US-285 meets US-50

waypoints.name: Montrose
waypoints.description: Final services before last 65-mile push to Telluride
